title: Still Done
subtitle: 历史古迹 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 历史古迹（人与社会·历史社会与文化·历史事件与人物）
meta: 主题语境：历史古迹（人与社会·历史社会与文化·历史事件与人物）　|　核心词汇：still　|　正文 319 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 still 的位置与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: ① Still, in 1964 the gardener stood the trowel at the bed, and everybody in the garden said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three springs on, people still spoke of that morning: before the April rains the gardener had ② still stood the trowel, and nobody had asked a single question. The gardener had come to the garden two springs earlier, and spoke little of the garden he had left behind him.

The notebook for April 1958 puts it plainer. The trowel was ③ still silent, and the apprentice who kept it had ④ still planted it twice before the winter came; nothing in the garden was ever done still in those days. The apprentice wrote that line himself and read it aloud once every spring thereafter.

My uncle, who kept the trowel at the far bed, meant something else. He stood the trowel ⑤ still twice over, and nobody in the garden doubted it; of all who stood it that spring, he stood it ⑥ still in silence. He was not a man who explained himself, and the garden had long since stopped asking him to.

By 1971 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the notebook. What the line asked for was that the trowel be planted ⑦ still every spring, and that whoever did it be ⑧ still careful about the whole business. Everybody laughed at the wording, and then did exactly what it said, as they always did. Everybody there knew the work had been done still.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1974 she stood the trowel ⑨ still in silence when nobody else would, and ⑩ Still, she said in 1976, that was the part the garden never forgot; the notebook still speaks still of it. She kept the trowel in the same bed for thirty years afterwards, and never once said why; the garden never forgot how still it had been done.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adv. 仍然（句中状语，置于助动词之后／动词之前：had still stood …，文中第 2、9 题两处）
B. adv. 仍然（修饰形容词：still silent）
C. adv. 依旧（评注性状语，置于句首：Still, …，文中第 1、10 题两处）
D. adv. 依旧（修饰过去分词：had still planted it）
E. adv. 仍然（句末状语：… still twice over）
F. adv. 仍然（句末状语：… still in silence，第 6 处）
G. adv. 依旧（被动结构中的中位状语：be planted still）
H. adv. 依旧（修饰形容词：be still careful about the whole business）

answers.why: still 意为“仍然”，此处置于句首作评注性状语，修饰整个句子：Still, in 1964 …。
still 意为“仍然”，此处置于助动词与过去分词之间修饰动词：had still stood the trowel。
still 意为“仍然”，此处修饰形容词 silent（沉默）：was still silent。
still 意为“依旧”，此处修饰过去分词 planted：had still planted it twice。
still 意为“仍然”，此处置于句末修饰动词：stood the trowel still twice over。
still 意为“仍然”，此处亦置于句末：of all who did it that 春天, he did it still in silence。
still 意为“依旧”，被动结构 be planted still 中，副词置于过去分词之后。
still 意为“依旧”，此处修饰形容词 careful（仔细）：be still careful about the whole business。
still 意为“仍然”，1974 年母亲在无人肯做时又一次站立那件小小的花铲，副词置于动词之后。
still 意为“依旧”，母亲 1976 年那句话以评注性状语开头：Still, …，修饰整句。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1964 年，园丁依旧在苗床站立那件小小的花铲；园子里人人都说那是头一回。（Still, …）
雨季到来之前，园丁已经仍然站立那件小小的花铲。（had still stood …）
那件小小的花铲当时仍然沉默。（still silent）
保管它的那位学徒在入冬前已经依旧把它插过两回。（had still planted it）
叔叔仍然站立那件小小的花铲，园子里没有一个人怀疑。（… still …）
在那个春天里做过这件事的人当中，他做得最仍然。（the stillest of all of them）
answers: Still, in 1964 the gardener stood the trowel at the bed.
Before the April rains the gardener had still stood the trowel.
The apprentice who kept it had still planted it twice before the winter came.
He stood the trowel still twice over, and nobody in the garden doubted it.
Of all who did it that spring, he did it still in silence.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 still 的 3 种不同位置（句首评注、句中、句末、被动结构中等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: Still, in 1964 the gardener stood the trowel, and nobody forgot it.
Before the April rains the gardener had still stood the trowel.
The trowel was still silent, or so the notebook says.
The apprentice had still planted it twice before the winter came.
My mother stood the trowel still in silence when nobody else would.
Still, the garden never forgot that part of the story.
